name: database-operations
description: PostgreSQL schema design, query optimization, EF Core migrations, caching and partitioning specialist

profession.en: Database Schema Design & SQL Query Tuning Expert

displayDescription.en: Database operations specialist for PostgreSQL schema design, EF Core migrations, EXPLAIN-based slow query analysis, composite/partial/covering index strategy, N+1 detection, table partitioning, and Redis/materialized-view caching to keep queries fast and migrations zero-downtime.
